WITH base_1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    db.contaazul_company_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(metric_date, DAY) AS Mes,
    CASE WHEN free.billing_legacy_company_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'FREE_ORIGEM' ELSE channel_1 END AS channel_1,
    daily_metric,
    CASE WHEN daily_metric = 'WINBACK' THEN 1 END AS WINBACK_Customer,
    Migracao.billing_legacy_company_id AS ID_Migracao,
    Fluxovelho.billing_legacy_company_id AS ID_FluxoVelho
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.silver_revenue.db_core_history` db
  LEFT JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.silver_revenue.smb_migrations` Migracao
    ON db.billing_legacy_company_id = Migracao.billing_legacy_company_id
  LEFT JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.silver_revenue.legacy_batch_flow_base` Fluxovelho
    ON db.billing_legacy_company_id = Fluxovelho.billing_legacy_company_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT billing_legacy_company_id
    FROM `contaazul-ssbi.silver_revenue.db_core_history`
    WHERE daily_metric = 'NEW' AND is_freemium = TRUE
  ) AS free ON free.billing_legacy_company_id = db.billing_legacy_company_id
  WHERE metric_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
),
base_1_adj AS (
  SELECT
    Mes,
    CASE
      WHEN channel_1 IN ('ACC','SMB') AND (ID_Migracao IS NOT NULL OR ID_FluxoVelho IS NOT NULL) THEN 'LOTE'
      WHEN channel_1 = 'BIZDEV' THEN 'SMB'
      ELSE channel_1
    END AS Canal_Adj,
    WINBACK_Customer
  FROM base_1
)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(WINBACK_Customer), 0) AS winback_total_julho
FROM base_1_adj
WHERE Canal_Adj IN ('SMB','ACC')

WITH base AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, metric_date, metric_type
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.bronze_db_bridge.core_metrics_daily_subscription_lifecycle`
  WHERE channel IN ('SMB','ACC') AND is_freemium = FALSE AND metric_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
entrada AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, MIN(metric_date) AS data_aquisicao
  FROM base
  WHERE metric_type = 'NEW'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING DATE_TRUNC(MIN(metric_date), MONTH) = DATE '2026-07-01'
),
estado AS (
  SELECT
    e.contaazul_company_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(p.new_step ORDER BY p.changed_at DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS playbook_step
  FROM entrada e
  LEFT JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_onboarding.fact_playbook_stage_lifecycle` p
    ON p.nk_company_id = e.contaazul_company_id
   AND p.is_deleted = FALSE
   AND p.changed_at >= DATETIME '2026-06-01'
   AND DATE(p.changed_at) <= DATE '2026-07-31'
  GROUP BY 1
),
recusa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT contaazul_company_id
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.silver_onboarding.onboarding_events`
  WHERE action = 'TRAINING_DECLINED_CLICKED' AND event_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(
  COUNTIF(s.playbook_step IS NOT NULL AND s.playbook_step NOT IN ('Criado','1ª Reunião','Finalizado','Abandono','Não Compareceu'))
    + COUNTIF(s.playbook_step = 'Finalizado'),
  COUNT(*) - COUNTIF(r.contaazul_company_id IS NOT NULL AND s.playbook_step IS NULL)
) AS cobertura_pct
FROM estado s
LEFT JOIN recusa r ON r.contaazul_company_id = s.contaazul_company_id

),
entrada AS (

  FROM base

),
estado AS (
  SELECT
    e.contaazul_company_id,
    e.data_aquisicao,
    ARRAY_AGG(p.new_step ORDER BY p.changed_at DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS playbook_step
  FROM entrada e
  LEFT JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_onboarding.fact_playbook_stage_lifecycle` p
    ON p.nk_company_id = e.contaazul_company_id
   AND p.is_deleted = FALSE
   AND p.changed_at >= DATETIME '2026-06-01'
   AND DATE(p.changed_at) <= DATE '2026-07-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
finalizacao AS (
  SELECT p.nk_company_id AS contaazul_company_id, MAX(DATE(p.changed_at)) AS data_finalizado
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_onboarding.fact_playbook_stage_lifecycle` p
  WHERE p.new_step = 'Finalizado' AND p.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.nk_company_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p.changed_at >= DATETIME '2026-06-01' AND DATE(p.changed_at) <= DATE '2026-07-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(
  COUNTIF(s.playbook_step = 'Finalizado'
          AND f.data_finalizado IS NOT NULL
          AND DATE_DIFF(f.data_finalizado, s.data_aquisicao, DAY) <= 15),
  COUNTIF(s.playbook_step = 'Finalizado')
) AS tempo_cobertura_pct
FROM estado s
LEFT JOIN finalizacao f ON f.contaazul_company_id = s.contaazul_company_id

WITH base AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, metric_date, metric_type
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.bronze_db_bridge.core_metrics_daily_subscription_lifecycle`
  WHERE channel IN ('SMB','ACC') AND is_freemium = FALSE AND metric_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
entrada AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, MIN(metric_date) AS data_aquisicao
  FROM base
  WHERE metric_type = 'NEW'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING DATE_TRUNC(MIN(metric_date), MONTH) = DATE '2026-07-01'
),
ult AS (
  SELECT nk_company_id, new_step, changed_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nk_company_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_onboarding.fact_playbook_stage_lifecycle`
  WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND nk_company_id IS NOT NULL AND changed_at >= DATETIME '2026-06-01'
    AND nk_company_id IN (SELECT contaazul_company_id FROM entrada)
),
fin AS (
  SELECT nk_company_id AS cid, DATE(changed_at) AS data_finalizado
  FROM ult WHERE rn = 1 AND new_step = 'Finalizado'
),
ref AS (
  SELECT LEAST(MAX(nk_date), DATE '2026-07-31') AS data_max
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_capro_features.fact_capro_features` WHERE nk_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
dias_uteis AS (
  SELECT f.cid, d.nk_date AS dia,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.cid ORDER BY d.nk_date) AS dia_util_n
  FROM fin f CROSS JOIN ref r
  JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date` d
    ON d.nk_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(f.data_finalizado, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                     AND LEAST(DATE_ADD(f.data_finalizado, INTERVAL 30 DAY), r.data_max)
   AND d.work_day > 0
),
uso AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.cid, c.nk_date AS dia
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_capro_features.fact_capro_features` c
  JOIN fin f ON f.cid = c.nk_company_id
  JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date` d ON d.nk_date = c.nk_date AND d.work_day > 0
  WHERE c.any_feature = TRUE AND c.nk_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND c.nk_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(f.data_finalizado, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(f.data_finalizado, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
),
marcado AS (
  SELECT du.cid, du.dia, du.dia_util_n, CASE WHEN u.dia IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inativo
  FROM dias_uteis du LEFT JOIN uso u ON u.cid = du.cid AND u.dia = du.dia
),
streak AS (
  SELECT cid, dia, dia_util_n,
    dia_util_n - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN inativo = 0 THEN dia_util_n END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY dia_util_n ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), 0) AS streak_atual
  FROM marcado
),
streak_ref AS (
  SELECT cid, ARRAY_AGG(streak_atual ORDER BY dia DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS streak_atual
  FROM streak WHERE dia <= DATE '2026-07-31' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(
  COUNTIF(DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-07-31', f.data_finalizado, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
          AND (sr.streak_atual IS NULL OR sr.streak_atual < 5)),
  COUNTIF(DATE_DIFF(DATE '2026-07-31', f.data_finalizado, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
) AS qualidade_setup_pct
FROM fin f LEFT JOIN streak_ref sr ON sr.cid = f.cid

WITH base AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, metric_date, metric_type
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.bronze_db_bridge.core_metrics_daily_subscription_lifecycle`
  WHERE channel IN ('SMB','ACC') AND is_freemium = FALSE AND metric_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
),
entrada AS (
  SELECT contaazul_company_id, MIN(metric_date) AS data_aquisicao
  FROM base
  WHERE metric_type = 'NEW' AND metric_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING DATE_TRUNC(MIN(metric_date), MONTH) = DATE '2026-07-01'
),
ref_dia AS (
  SELECT MAX(nk_date) AS dia_ref
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date`
  WHERE work_day > 0 AND nk_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
),
dias AS (
  SELECT d.nk_date AS dia
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date` d
  WHERE d.work_day > 0
    AND d.nk_date BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(data_aquisicao) FROM entrada) AND (SELECT dia_ref FROM ref_dia)
),
grade AS (
  SELECT e.contaazul_company_id AS cid, e.data_aquisicao, d.dia,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.contaazul_company_id ORDER BY d.dia) AS du_vida
  FROM entrada e JOIN dias d ON d.dia >= e.data_aquisicao
),
uso_diario AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.nk_company_id AS cid, f.nk_date AS dia
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_capro_features.fact_capro_features` f
  JOIN entrada e ON e.contaazul_company_id = f.nk_company_id
  JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date` d ON d.nk_date = f.nk_date AND d.work_day > 0
  WHERE f.any_feature = TRUE AND f.nk_date >= e.data_aquisicao AND f.nk_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND f.nk_date <= (SELECT dia_ref FROM ref_dia)
),
grade_mv AS (
  SELECT g.cid, g.data_aquisicao, g.dia, g.du_vida,
    IF(u.dia IS NULL, 0, 1) AS usou,
    CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(g.dia, MONTH), DATE '2026-07-01', MONTH) + 1 AS INT64) AS mes_vida
  FROM grade g LEFT JOIN uso_diario u ON u.cid = g.cid AND u.dia = g.dia
),
grade_seq AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cid, mes_vida ORDER BY dia) AS seq FROM grade_mv
),
grade_streak AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(IF(usou = 1, seq, NULL)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY cid, mes_vida ORDER BY seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ult_seq_uso
  FROM grade_seq
),
inat AS (
  SELECT cid, dia,
    (du_vida >= 5 AND DATE_DIFF(dia, data_aquisicao, DAY) + 1 >= 7)
    AND ((CASE WHEN usou = 1 THEN 0 ELSE seq - COALESCE(ult_seq_uso, 0) END) >= 5) AS flag_inativo
  FROM grade_streak
),
assinante_dia AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.contaazul_company_id AS cid, b.metric_date AS dia
  FROM base b
  JOIN entrada e ON e.contaazul_company_id = b.contaazul_company_id
  JOIN `contaazul-ssbi.gold_common.dim_date` d ON d.nk_date = b.metric_date AND d.work_day > 0
  WHERE b.metric_type NOT IN ('CHURN','OVERDUE')
    AND b.metric_date >= e.data_aquisicao AND b.metric_date <= (SELECT dia_ref FROM ref_dia)
)
SELECT COUNTIF(s.cid IS NOT NULL AND u.cid IS NULL AND COALESCE(i.flag_inativo, FALSE)) AS clientes_zona_risco
FROM grade g
LEFT JOIN assinante_dia s ON s.cid = g.cid AND s.dia = g.dia
LEFT JOIN uso_diario u ON u.cid = g.cid AND u.dia = g.dia
LEFT JOIN inat i ON i.cid = g.cid AND i.dia = g.dia
WHERE g.dia = (SELECT dia_ref FROM ref_dia)

WITH carteira_raw AS (
  SELECT
    nk_company_id,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m', NULLIF(cohort_month, 'unknown')) AS safra,
    NULLIF(portfolio_entry_date, DATE '0001-01-01') AS entrada,
    LEAST(
      IFNULL(NULLIF(email_sent_at,    DATE '0001-01-01'), DATE '9999-12-31'),
      IFNULL(NULLIF(whatsapp_sent_at, DATE '0001-01-01'), DATE '9999-12-31')
    ) AS contato,
    LEAST(
      IFNULL(NULLIF(responded_at, DATE '0001-01-01'), DATE '9999-12-31'),
      IFNULL(DATE(NULLIF(whatsapp_replied_at, DATETIME '0001-01-01 00:00:00')), DATE '9999-12-31')
    ) AS respondeu
  FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_onboarding.dim_adoption_portfolio`
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(
  COUNTIF(entrada <= DATE '2026-07-31' AND contato <= DATE '2026-07-31' AND respondeu <= DATE '2026-07-31'),
  COUNTIF(entrada <= DATE '2026-07-31' AND contato <= DATE '2026-07-31')
) AS conversao_wpp_email_pct
FROM carteira_raw
WHERE safra = DATE '2026-07-01' AND entrada IS NOT NULL
